newsitem.title: USA: NY/NJ Port Authority approves $1.2 bln bond issue.
newsitem.headline: NY/NJ Port Authority approves $1.2 bln bond issue.

text.p: The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey Board of Commissioners on Thursday voted to approve a $1.2 billion special projects bond issue for construction of a building at John F Kennedy International Airport in New York City.
The Port Authority said it expects to begin construction on the new international arrivals building for JFK to begin this year.
Details of when the bonds would be sold were not immediately available.
"It's time to stop appologizing for JFK and get about the business of rebuilding it," said George Marlin, executive director of the Port Authority.
